mo_ta_cong_viec:
We are looking for an experienced IT Test Manager to lead the QA function for POEMS, our multi-asset trading platform across web and mobile.
You will lead a QA team and be responsible for testing strategy, quality assurance, release readiness, and continuous improvement. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Trading, Operations, and other teams to ensure our trading platform is reliable, secure, and high quality.
Key Responsibilities
1. QA Strategy & Quality Management
Define and manage the overall QA strategy, testing standards, processes, and quality roadmap.
Ensure consistent testing practices and quality standards across projects and releases.
2. Team Management & Leadership
Lead, mentor, and develop the QA team.
Manage team resources, performance, hiring, and career development.
Build a collaborative and high-performing QA team.
3. Test Planning & Delivery
Manage test planning and execution across functional, regression, integration, system, and UAT testing.
Coordinate QA activities across multiple projects and releases.
Manage testing priorities, risks, and delivery commitments.
4. Trading Platform Testing
Drive QA for key trading functions, including order management, trade execution, market data, risk, and settlement.
Ensure the accuracy, reliability, and integrity of critical trading workflows.
5. Technical & Automation
Guide the team on test automation, API, database, performance, and security testing.
Promote appropriate use of automation to improve testing efficiency and coverage.
6. Release & Quality Management
Manage defects, testing risks, and release quality.
Define quality criteria and provide QA sign-off and release recommendations.
7. Process Improvement & Metrics
Continuously improve QA processes, tools, and testing practices.
Monitor QA metrics and identify areas for improvement.
8. Stakeholder Management
Work closely with Product, Engineering, Trading, Operations, and other stakeholders to resolve quality issues.
Communicate testing status, risks, and recommendations to management.
9. Compliance & Risk
Ensure testing practices consider relevant security, compliance, and data privacy requirements.

Overall Experience
8–10 years of experience in software QA/testing.
Have experience in managing and leading QA teams.
QA Expertise
Strong hands-on experience in test planning, execution, defect management, regression testing, and release quality.
Experience managing QA delivery across multiple projects or releases.
Trading & Capital Markets
Experience testing trading or capital markets platforms is required.
Good understanding of trading workflows such as order management, trade execution, market data, risk, and settlement.
Experience with equities, derivatives, CFDs, forex, funds, or bonds is an advantage.
Technical Skills
Good technical knowledge of API, SQL/database testing, test automation, and performance testing.
Familiarity with Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, Postman, JMeter, Jira, or TestRail is an advantage.
Good understanding of Agile/Scrum and CI/CD practices.
Leadership & Delivery Management
Strong ability to lead QA activities, manage priorities, resources, risks, and delivery commitments.
Strong people-management, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
Communication
Professional-level written and spoken English is mandatory.
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field.
